He received the Padma Shri in 2011 and Sangita Kala Acharya from the Music Academy Madras in 1997. Carnatic Music is the major classical music tradition of South India and is especially associated with Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
